title: Hinss et al. 2021 — Open multi-session and multi-task EEG cognitive Dataset for passive brain-computer Interface Applications
description: This dataset contains multi-session EEG recordings from 15 healthy participants performing a resting-state condition and the MATB-II multitasking paradigm at three difficulty levels (easy, medium, difficult). It was designed for passive brain-computer interface research, particularly cross-session and cross-subject mental workload estimation in neuroergonomics. Data were recorded with a 62-channel active-electrode system at 500 Hz and are provided in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 500 Hz from 62 active Ag/AgCl electrodes (ActiCHamp, Brain Products) placed according to the 10-20 system, referenced to Fpz, with an additional ECG channel. Impedances were kept below 25 kOhm. Each of two sessions per participant included resting state and MATB-II task blocks of easy, medium and difficult levels.
